description: bin/lib/config.ts is the only reader and writer of .paper/config.toml (smol-toml + zod, schema_version, migrations, unknown-key warnings, the verify_quotes and paper-level endpoint/api_key_env refusals). Nothing else imports smol-toml or builds a path from the bare 'config.toml' segment; paths.ts and state.ts may name it for the legacy root-file move (RUN-13). Everything else calls readPaperConfigSync / tryReadPaperConfigSync / loadPaperConfig / updatePaperConfig / paperConfigPath.
